config.contextThresholds.description: Context gauge thresholds in tokens: the yellow and orange zones.
config.allowBypassPermissions.descriptio: Allow the bypassPermissions mode (run tools without confirmations).
config.defaultPermissionMode.description: Permission mode a new session starts with. In an open session the mode is changed in the menu under the input field.
config.defaultPermissionMode.enum.manual: Ask for permission on edits and commands
config.defaultPermissionMode.enum.plan: Plan first, no edits until approved
config.defaultPermissionMode.enum.bypass: No confirmations (only if agentura.allowBypassPermissions is on, otherwise acts as manual)
config.defaultEffort.description: Effort of new sessions (how much to think before answering); empty means the engine default.
config.defaultModel.description: Default model for new sessions (empty means the engine default).
config.claudeExecutable.description: Path to the claude executable (empty: look for the system one: PATH, ~/.local/bin, Homebrew). The version is checked on the first engine start. User settings only: workspace settings are ignored.
config.usagePollMinutes.description: How often to poll subscription limits, in minutes.
config.sessionList.view.description: Session list view in the sidebar. Also switched with the button in the “Sessions” header.
config.sessionList.view.enum.detailed: Detailed: two lines per session — the title, then turns and cost below it
config.sessionList.view.enum.compact: Compact: one line, except the current, running and waiting-for-reply sessions
config.sessionList.view.enum.dense: Dense: one line for every session, details in the tooltip
config.sessionList.context.description: Show the last-request context column in the session list (173k ctx).
config.sessionList.time.description: Show the time column in the session list (now, 13:05, Tue, 25.09).
config.sidebar.top.description: Sidebar top view: how much room the account, limits and “New Session” take.
config.sidebar.top.enum.detailed: Detailed: the account as a table, each limit with a gauge and a reset line
config.sidebar.top.enum.compact: Compact: the account and each limit on one line, “New Session” as a ＋ button in the “Sessions” header
config.sidebar.top.enum.dense: Dense: limits as mini-gauges in the panel header, the account in a tooltip
config.feed.style.description: Chat feed view: how a turn is laid out. Applies to open chat tabs immediately.
config.feed.style.enum.journal: Journal: a flat log of rows, as before
config.feed.style.enum.folded: Folded: finished turns collapse their actions into one line
config.feed.style.enum.replies: Replies: your message as a bubble, actions as chips
config.feed.style.enum.cards: Cards: each turn is a card with a timeline of actions
config.font.interface.description: Font for Agentura panels: chat text, settings, sidebar. Empty: the VS Code interface font. If the font is not installed, the VS Code font is used.
config.font.panels.description: Font for the header, the input box and the right and left panels. Empty: as before (the chat chrome is monospace, the sidebar uses the interface font). If the font is not installed, the VS Code interface font is used.
config.font.code.description: Monospace font for code and the chat feed log. Empty: the VS Code editor font (editor.fontFamily). If the font is not installed, the editor font is used.
config.feed.fontSize.description: Chat feed text size, px (10–20). Everything in the feed scales together: replies, actions, code. Default 13.
config.language.description: Agentura interface language. Applies after the window reloads.
config.language.enum.auto: Same as VS Code: Russian when VS Code is in Russian, English otherwise
config.limits.readKeychain.description: Read the Claude Code token from the macOS Keychain to request subscription limits (/api/oauth/usage). The token is used only for that request and sent nowhere else. Without it, on macOS the 5-hour and weekly percentages are unavailable until the first turn (then from the engine response) if ~/.claude/.credentials.json does not exist.
